metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.loadFailed: Could not refresh metrics. Select Refresh to retry. Any data below is the previous result.
metrics.methodology: Operation counters from the API for each account’s current reporting window. Three deck variants count as one generation. In-progress operations are counted separately.
metrics.partial: Some accounts could not be loaded. They remain in the list; totals requiring their data are hidden. Select Refresh to retry.
metrics.totalsHint: Totals cover matching accounts. “—” means data is unavailable, incomplete, or reporting windows differ. These values are not added together. Storage is current usage, not usage during a period.
metrics.accountFailed: Could not load this account’s data. Select Refresh to retry.

metricHints.generation: Three finished variants count as one generation.
metricHints.image: Pictures inside a deck do not count here. Standalone image generation is not available yet.
metricHints.concurrency: How many builds may run at once.
metricHints.storage: How much space this account's presentations and files take.

limits.title: Activity and limits
limits.everyoneHint: The shared policy. A person's own limit replaces it only for them.
limits.personalHint: Personal values replace the shared policy. “Same as everyone” returns to it.
limits.zero: Zero blocks new operations. Saved results stay available.
limits.invalid: Check the values and the time zone.
limits.loadFailed: Could not load the data. Select Retry.
limits.modelsHint: Configure model connections, shared models and role assignments in model settings.
limits.unsavedScope: The current account has unsaved changes.
limits.previewHint: Settings have not been applied. Counters follow the saved policy; their reporting windows will be recalculated after saving.

usage.title: Activity and limits
usage.hint: An administrator sets the limits. Three finished variants count as one generation.
usage.loadFailed: Could not load. Reopen settings to retry.

unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Opening another section will discard them.
